name: ecommerce-api-qa-automation
description: Postman/Newman API test automation suite for an e-commerce product management API.

scripts.test: newman run "E-Commerce API QA Automation.postman_collection.json" -e "E-Commerce QA Environment.postman_environment.json"
scripts.test:report: newman run "E-Commerce API QA Automation.postman_collection.json" -e "E-Commerce QA Environment.postman_environment.json" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/report.html

author: Aleksandar Radovanović
